title: Dry run: solution-2 diagonalSum on [[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]]

steps.note: Get the size of the matrix.
Add mat[1][1]. The center cell is counted here, the first time.
Add mat[2][2]. The primary diagonal is done: 1 + 5 + 9 = 15.
Second loop (secondary diagonal): column = size-1-j = 2. Add mat[0][2].
Column = 3-1-1 = 1, so this adds mat[1][1] again. The center 5 has now been counted TWICE. That's expected; the if below is supposed to remove the extra 5.
BUG: the condition is backwards. The diagonals share a center cell only when size is ODD, but this checks for EVEN. 3 % 2 = 1, so the check is false and the extra 5 is never subtracted.
Returns 30, but the expected answer is 25. The difference is exactly the double-counted center (5).
